S.FORM: == mitupinay tu labang a balunga 遊艇 == mitupinay tu labang a balunga (igu: yacht, namaka He-lan a kamuan: jacht ) u sakay papahanhanan nu kawawan " mahida u pacunaay, papacemutan tu buting, kapulungan masakaputay, sasasetsetan sa" a micapiay tu dadipasan nanay a bayuan " langdaway a nanum" atu minininggukayay a bayuan " sumilaway a nanum" nu balungaan, mihelupay tu bali nu payapayan a balungaan " sailing yaht", sisapaday a balungaan " hydrofoil yacht", sibesuay a balungaan " hovercraft Yacht", lalaay sisapaday nu balungaan " Ground Effect Wing Yacht", hunsiki a balungaan " jet yacht" atu kikayay nu balungaan " motor yacht" enem a kasasidumaan. aydaay a imian ina balungaan u caay sipakayda i tulaku mikacaw a patasasa, u adidiay a minatuan musaluimeng a caay kaw tabakiay nu balungaan, i nu udip ta a balungan ku mahiniay. hucunu tanayu a balunga makaala tu 9.8—10.7 kun-ce, tabakiay a balungaan makaala tu 30 kun-ce, milakuyt tu 61 kun-ce a micidekay tu nu tabakiay a balungaan " superyacht". 遊艇(英語:yacht,源自荷蘭語:jacht) ( hovercraft Yacht), . mahiniay a mitupinay tu labang a balungaan caay kaw matekesay, ina tabakiay nu kapahay a balungaan nu aydaay u sakapahay a balungaan, pangangan han tu sapitupin tu labang a balungaan han sakay sasasetsetan atu sapilakalakay a balungaan. adidaiay nu sapituping tu labangan a balungaan u aca hakiya mikikaka tu nu udipay a kadideng hakiya mikikakaac tu ac, u sapatahekal hakiya yadah tu, pasu paya nu aca, sasaluimengan i minatu a sapatahekal, sakay banangan a sapatahekalan, mapeci' sapisanga, papadumaan tu duguan, pacunaay a sakakaay nu sapatahekalan, mikuwanay a midiputy, hukin tu a kakalisiwan, sisa u siidaay ku mahiniay a aaidangan, anu idaw ku nu udip a mahiniay a balungaan u sakaudip atu sakay syakay nu mamamelawan. caayay pakaala tina mahiniay a aca nu balungaan, idaw ku suyen nanay idaw ku cukibalay nanay tu sapisingsingan. . sakay piliwkuan nu balungaan u mikacaway a tademaw kanca talakaw ku nipiyukiwan, sisa u sapisanga tu balungaan a zayliwan talakaw tu ku nipiyukiw. amica ku bangcal nu hekal, sademsem enengan, nipisangaan nu zayliwan ahican a caay kaw kapahay pasukikay atu ancin aw kapahay namin. ayda u sangan tu balungan nu udipan a zayliwan u malatusaay namin ku zayliw, mahini tanektek ku mahiniay a sangan nu balungaan, kudeced, bangcal ku hekal, kapah ku culil. udip nu balunga a malatusaay nu zayliwan a hekal mu nu mukin a galasuan ku zayliw, galasu nu mukin u galasu sikeliway ku sapicunus tu icelang nu zayliw atu nuli nu kilang ku sapaduhepit a mamaduhepitay nu zayliwan, sakaylabu a zayliwan i teban hina u pa-sa-cin-mu ((BALTEK nu kilangan) atu sibulangay nu teban a zayliwan (ALREX nu kilangan). i 50 ce katukuh i 80 ce ku kaku nu balungan, kakenihen misausi u kayakayay nu balunga, sakatayda i pabaw nu sapadan atu hekal nu balungan makayda i pabaw katukuh i sasa. kayakayay nu balunga kanca macunu tu cacayay a sapacuna nu tademaw. makaylalabuan a sangan, kanca idaw ku tapang nu kakabian, tahudan nu labang, kakabian nu labang, paladah atu sapianmuoan, u tanayu kuhan. (BALTEK系列)以及泡沫芯材(AIREX系列).以50呎至80 . sisingpukiay nu balunga風扇艇 sisingpukiay nu balunga (Fanboat,Airboat), atu pangangan han u sisingpukiay a balunga, duhepicay singpukiay nu balunga, u siizingay nu kulupilaan mibabelihay ku nipabali tu bali talaayaway nu duhepicay a balungaan, ya ingzing atu kulupila mapaedep i mukinan, metalaw a mahica ku balunga, aadupan atu mikacaway a labang metalaw kaletepan a maduka. pasayda i nikudan ku nikasibalian tu sapacumud i labu nu balungaan, nu pasidikuday a bali ku mamikuwa tu pasacuwaay a balian, hina i sakay lanulanuan atu sakayhekahekalan tu sakatasasaan nu kulupila caay kaw aitida. 風扇艇(Fanboat,Airboat), . likisi歷史 sayaway nu kulupilaay a balunga u ci la'cusan a tadukan , u Ya-li-san-ta.Ke-la-han-mu. Pey-e-se ha-ka-si nu mililiday a masakaputay itini i caysiwseplim mihcaan misangan tu Ciw-na-ta a Sin-su-ke-sia. u nanaman tu cacancanan a inzingna atu kulupila a sapatidengan. . liwsin lalangawan流行文化 kulupila a balungaan itida i tusepcaylim mihcaan sayaway nipanganganan u mikuwangay nu sasalamaan " kalepacawan nu kitidaan: pacici malepacaw"(Battlefield: Hardline) sapacabay tu M134 " mikacaway tu sakalelpacaw a duguan" nu nanum atu i dadanan nu balungaan a sakatahekal, cacukaymasan mahida u " kalepacawan nu igaan 4: malawilaway nu bali a kugun" nu dadanay atu bayuay a mabesuay nu balungaan. "(Battlefield: Hardline)中搭配M134 .
